2014_spells.elemental-weapon.description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. For the duration, the weapon has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type.
2014_spells.elemental-weapon.effectSumma: the weapon has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type
2014_spells.elemental-weapon.fullDescrip: Using 1 action, a nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon. For the duration, the weapon has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type; Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 1 hour.
